SELECT MIN(ll.create_time) createTime, ll.user_id, u.actual_name AS userName, ll.remote_ip, ll.remote_browser, ll.access_terminal, ll.remote_os FROM t_user_login_log ll left join t_base_user u on u.id = ll.user_id where ll.login_type = 1 and ll.login_status = 1
AND ll.access_terminal = #{query.visitRecordPlateType}
AND DATE(ll.create_time ) = CURDATE()
AND YEARWEEK(ll.create_time, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1)
AND YEAR(ll.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(ll.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE())
AND DATE(ll.create_time) BETWEEN #{query.visitRecordStartDate} AND #{query.visitRecordEndDate}
GROUP BY DATE(ll.create_time),ll.access_terminal,ll.remote_os order by MIN(ll.create_time) desc
